findings.message: Hero headline is 11 words ("FIND YOUR PEOPLE. BUILD SOMETHING TOGETHER. LEARN BUILD SHAR"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "A Student-Driven Community" above "FIND YOUR PEOPLE. BUILD SOMETHING TOGETH"; "A community in motion" above "LEARN. CONNECT. GROW."; "01 / Beyond the classroom" above "REAL-WORLD INSIGHTS FROM PEOPLE WHO ACTU"; "Our event archive" above "EXPLORE THE JOURNEY SO FAR."; "The Community" above "A COMMUNITY BUILT BY STUDENTS, FOR STUDE"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "09", "01 / Beyond the classroom"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 20 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "A Student-Driven Community", "Editions", "So Far", "Host Venues").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 7 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-x-[18%] → radial-gradient(at 50% 100%, rgb(240, 187, 121) 0%, rgb(246, 223, 187) 37%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 73%) | div.eaf-folder-art.eaf-art-0 → radial-gradient(at 50% 90%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 45%), linear-gradient(140deg, rgb(223, | div.eaf-folder-front → linear-gradient(165deg, rgb(255, 249, 236), rgb(233, 216, 186) 96%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 18 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.overflow-hidden → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.relative.rounded-3xl → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | a.group.flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(28, 25,
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 12 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.relative.grid 784px | section.py-6.sm:py-8 1440px | div.flex.flex-col 1134px | div.mt-6.flex 286px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 19 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 5 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #faf7f2, section #faf7f2, section #fff8f0).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Voices of the community" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Read review" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Read review" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Read review" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 4 typefaces in use (Inter, Bricolage Grotesque, ui-serif, Fraunces).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 106 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 33 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 60px (4.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 35% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: The margins differ: 90px on the left, 58px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (112px, 159px, 565px, 141px, 90px, 385px, 491px); the three most used hold only 39% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 963px of nothing between: "Real People. Real Impact."
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
